response.overview: Takht-e Soleyman is a short documentary portrait of an elderly shepherd living in the ancient landscape of Takht-e Soleyman, Iran. As he walks through the mountains and pastures, he recalls memories of his youth, lost times, and the changes that have shaped his life. Through his voice, weathered face, and the surrounding silence of nature, the film becomes a meditation on memory, aging, and the deep bond between a human being and the land he has spent a lifetime with.
response.tagline: A lifetime remembered in the silence of the mountains.
response.title: Takhte Soleyman
